description: This file defines the HostedClient class in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which manages a client hosted within a silo. It includes message handling, extension management, lifecycle participation, and component handling.

classes.name: HostedClient
classes.description: Represents a client instance hosted within a silo, responsible for message processing, extension management, and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: CreateHostedClientGrainId
methods.description: Creates a GrainId for a hosted client based on the silo address.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a grain reference for a given object, registering it as an observer.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deregisters a grain reference object, verifying it as an observer reference.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a component of the specified type, creating or returning cached instances.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Sets or removes a component instance of the specified type.

methods.name: TryDispatchToClient
methods.description: Dispatches a message to this client if it is addressed to it.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message and routes it appropriately based on its direction.

methods.name: RunClientMessagePump
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous loop processing incoming messages from the channel.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes lifecycle events for starting and stopping the client.

methods.name: GetOrSetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves or registers a new extension of a given type.

methods.name: TryGetExtension
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an existing extension with generic or specific type.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves or creates and registers an extension of specified interface type.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Method for activation, no-op in this context.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Method to deactivate, no-op in this context.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Handles rehydration, here simply disposing of context if applicable.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Migration attempts, not supported in this context.
